# Synthetic PDF signature fixtures

These test-only bytes were generated by
`experiments/document-semantic-inspection/tests/support/signature_pdf.rs`
using `build_pdf_byte_range_fixture` for the Valid, Tampered, and
MalformedByteRange variants. The DER file is the matching synthetic test
certificate. The source contains a fixed test-only key; no live credential
is present in these fixtures.

| `tampered.pdf` | `cfac78d7cac7f2f2c2f02ddf07e9e748c388d26aa3ac2dc70207859bbd617722` |
| `malformed.pdf` | `b67c1df4b1f2279fe96c213d92543479382451b67e303628e46c9a6b12fd75fd` |
